title: Phase 2 Complete
body:
Phase two has been complete. ZG and BWL have been patched and tuned for solo play. Many changes went into making this. View all commits here https://github.com/m0nnnna/wow/commits/main/.
Also rogue healing! Rogues instant poisons now heal themselves for a set amount of damage tied to the same proc. All changes and patches pushed will be updated the 21st at 8AM EST.
